title: FitSquad admin MVP operations scope
description: Define the smallest useful admin panel scope for Phase 1 reservation operations. Limit the scope to reservation visibility, contact details, package reference, participant count, and payment status with optional manual status updates. Exclude dashboards, finance reports, CRM behavior, and advanced workflow automation.
acceptance_criteria: define the minimum reservation fields visible to staff
define the minimum actions staff need in Phase 1
define what should remain manual outside the system
keep the admin scope explicitly aligned to Phase 1 constraints
